description:
Return counted arrivals beside Meta outbound clicks for the authorized workspace and selected trailing window. The conversions block counts retained logical events under the current workspace conversion choices and publishes its selection version, completed local-day period, and availability. The purchases block shows Meta-reported Purchase counts under the account attribution setting beside Plainrouter accepted server-side Purchase counts, with its completed account-local window end date and no purchase gap or status. Days before 2026-06-29, or not re-read by the daily sync since 2026-09-27, may still hold Meta link clicks or all clicks.
basis_note explains how the two counts differ.

days.description: Trailing window in days. One of 7, 30, 90.

months.description: Trailing window of 12 calendar months, in place of days. Offered only where the workspace plan keeps that history and the workspace is set to keep it.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID returned by list_workspaces. Required when this credential reaches multiple workspaces.
